name: Munki V3
summary:
Welcome to Munki 3! We're thrilled to have you join us on this adventure. Sadly, our previous version had to bid farewell due to a mishap with the APK, but fear not, for we're back and better than ever! Get ready for a slew of updates in the pipeline, promising more excitement and thrills than ever before. Explore new maps, traverse through dense forests, and brace yourself for the spine-chilling horror that awaits in our yet-to-be-finished horror mode.
